The game session has ended, or the player has made a menu selection to view statistics.

trigger.raw_text: The Player selects a menu option to view statistics, or the game session ends.

claims.content: The Player initiates the view by ending the game session or selecting a menu option to view statistics.
The system reads the recorded player statistics (name, number of block movements, time taken) from the statistic file.
The system displays the Player Statistics Window, composed of a listbox showing the recorded statistics.
The Player may choose to erase all recorded statistics via a menu selection, causing the system to clear the data in the statistic file.

If the player's block movement count is not lower than the highest recorded (i.e., they did not achieve a top score), the system displays a 'Simple Finish Window' instead of the 'Finish Window with Statistics' before showing the statistics window.
If the system cannot update the statistic file due to wrong permissions, an error message is displayed.
If the system cannot update the statistic file because the disk is full, an error message is displayed.
The Player Statistics Window is displayed, composed of a listbox showing recorded statistics.
Each line in the listbox contains the player's name, number of block movements, and time taken to solve the headache.
The statistics are read from the statistic file of the game.
